declare.hazard0: METAL_RUNTIME_HAZARD_BARRIERS=0 → always-on Device barrier after every dispatch (golden-safe)
declare.hazard1: METAL_RUNTIME_HAZARD_BARRIERS=1 → skip auto; explicit RAW at phase edges (coarse by default)
declare.default: env unset → GemmaGpu::new_inference sets skip_auto=true (same shipping path as hazard1)
declare.what_numbers_measure: Real E4B Q4 Hot decode tok/s (16 steps after prefill T=4); TRACE off; FUSE_LAYER off. Mini-graph lines in same logs are not the gate metric.

verdict.note: Always-on costs ~5 tok/s on E4B (~27% relative). Keep shipping default = hazard ON; use =0 for golden/parity.
